photos.c: Left: The Paarlauf - a meeting of old friends. The Mitchell Brothers and Arthur Bruce are regulars. Frank Mitchell, left, coached Mitcham's international 800m runner Tony Harris while brother Ron, centre, will have been a Belgravian for 50 years in 1998. Arthur Bruce, right, needs no introduction.
